title: WHAT IS A MESSAGE QUEUE?

beats.caption: Your app sends work to a server. Usually that's fine…
…until traffic spikes. Requests slam the server faster than it can handle them.
A message queue sits in between: bursts pile up safely, and the server takes work at its own pace.
Need more speed? Add another worker. The queue feeds them both — nothing is lost.
Queues turn panic into a waiting line. That's the whole trick.
